scope: Class-relative construction correctness, protected constructor argument hints, and proof withdrawal for overridable targets.

reproduction.source: <?php abstract class Base {public static function make(){return new static;}} class Child extends Base {}
<?php abstract class Base {public static function make(){return new static();}} class Child extends Base {}
<?php trait Maker {public static function make(){return new self;}} class Child {use Maker;}
<?php trait Maker {public static function make(){return new self();}} class Child {use Maker;}
<?php class Base {protected function __construct(int $value){}} class Child extends Base {public static function make(){return new self;}}
<?php class Base {protected function __construct(int $value){}} class Child extends Base {public static function make(){return new self();}}

implementation.invalidTargets: Abstract-class static and Trait-relative self/static are not literal invalid instantiations; direct abstract/Trait names and enum static still rejected.
implementation.access: Both completed and omitted argument lists use existing memberVisibilityAllowed for protected family access.
implementation.diagnosticProof: Unknown consumer or overridable static constructor withdraws definite arity/type/visibility proof. Final class or final constructor preserves proven contracts.
implementation.cacheProof: Three snapshot restore modes alternate ordinary/final/ordinary imported constructors and withdraw/recover the current required parameter diagnostic.
